state.description: What names this delegation to dev.knotless.awaitDelegation.

main.description: Asks this appview's gateway, with a service token the account's PDS mints for the session the appview keeps for it, to take its writes (dev.knotless.putDelegation). The gateway asks the account's authorization server for a grant of its own, of the knotless records and blobs alone, which the account approves at the page this answers with; dev.knotless.awaitDelegation then waits for that. Once approved, sharing a repository for writing names the gateway, through which collaborators push. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Starts delegating the writes of the account logged in to this appview's pages to the appview's gateway, as `knotless account delegate` does.
